goal: Prevent release binary verification from accepting expired or revoked keys toward the signature quorum
Avoids reporting releases as verified when signatures come only from compromised or defunct keys
Allows opt-in inclusion of expired keys when verifying historical releases
reviewability: Ready to review; all reviewer concerns have been addressed in pushed updates
agreement: Strong support after testing verification on releases 22.1 through 31.1 (willcl-ark)
Concerns about verifying older releases resolved by adding an opt-in expired key flag (sedited, willcl-ark)
Agreed to leave signature de-duplication to a follow-up (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because release verification could pass using revoked keys, weakening release integrity guarantees
Prevents false-positive verification runs when all provided signatures are compromised

categories.name: tools
why: P2 because verification tooling counted revoked and expired keys toward minimum required signatures
Fixes a responsibly disclosed flaw while retaining historical release verification via an explicit flag
